title: Why Object is the superclass of Java classes
answer: Object gives ordinary reference types a common root so generic APIs can hold, inspect, compare, synchronize on, and stringify values through one minimum contract. The common root enables uniform APIs, while specific behavior still comes from the runtime class and declared contracts.
